turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Let me do one first.
I see the word "owl" (a bird). It starts with a vowel sound, "ow". So I write: I see an owl.
Rule: say an before a vowel sound and a before a consonant sound.
Right: I see a bird.
Wrong: I see an bird.

Your turn. Write only the missing word:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
